name: What is bathroom addition framing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathroom addition framing is the initial construction phase where the structural skeleton of your new bathroom is built. This involves creating walls, floors, and ceiling supports using wood or metal studs, according to the architectural plans. Proper framing establishes the precise dimensions, layout, and placement for all fixtures, doors, and windows, ensuring the addition is structurally sound and ready for plumbing, electrical, and finishing work. It's a critical step that dictates the overall integrity and functionality of the new space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom addition framing is the structural build of walls, floors, and ceilings for a new bathroom, based on architectural plans. It defines the layout and ensures structural integrity before other installations.
